findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when TopicUser row is missing
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb TopicsController#unsubscribe does tu = TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id]) and then immediately reads tu.notification_level. A user who was never tracked in TopicUser (the normal case for a user with default regular level) gets nil, so the request raises NoMethodError and returns 500 instead of unsubscribing. The code must handle nil by creating the row or using TopicUser.change.

findings.title: State-changing GET allows CSRF/crawler unsubscribes
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb the new TopicsController#unsubscribe is routed via GET in config/routes.rb and unconditionally mutates notification_level then saves. GETs are prefetched by browsers, crawlers, link scanners and can be embedded as an image, so an attacker can force a logged-in victim to be muted from a topic without consent. Mutating actions must not be GET; use POST/PUT with CSRF protection or make GET render-only.

findings.title: Direct save bypasses notification-level side effects
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb the unsubscribe action assigns tu.notification_level directly and calls tu.save!, instead of using TopicUser.change. TopicUser.change sets notifications_changed_at, notifications_reason_id, publishes MessageBus notification_level_change and runs observe_after_save_callbacks_for. The direct save leaves timestamps/reasons stale and connected clients out of sync.

findings.title: Unsubscribe only steps down one level
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb the logic is if tu.notification_level > regular then set to regular else set to muted. A watching/tracking user clicking the email Stop receiving notifications link is only demoted to regular and will still receive notifications, contradicting the email and locale text. Repeated visits further demote to muted, so the endpoint is non-idempotent and confusing.

findings.title: New unsubscribe_link interpolation breaks emails without unsubscribe_url
findings.body: In config/locales/server.en.yml unsubscribe_link now requires both %{user_preferences_url} and %{unsubscribe_url}. In lib/email/message_builder.rb MessageBuilder#body and #html_part call I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) whenever add_unsubscribe_link is true. Any caller that sets add_unsubscribe_link without passing unsubscribe_url now raises I18n missing interpolation and fails to send email. The builder needs a default or fallback when unsubscribe_url is absent.

findings.title: createRecord with existing id duplicates store record
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6 model() does this.store.createRecord('topic', {id: params.id}) then PostStream.loadTopicView. If the topic is already in the Ember store, createRecord creates a second unsaved record with the same id, causing duplicate-record/identity-map conflicts and dirty-state issues. It should find/reuse the existing record, and the promise rejection from loadTopicView is unhandled, leaving a blank page on 404/forbidden.
